O My Afnan! Upon thee be My glory and loving-kindness. The letter of the honored Afnan T.Q., upon him be My glory and loving-kindness, which he sent to thee was read in the presence of this Wronged One. Through its mention, the gate of bounty was opened, and through its heart's yearning, the ocean of mercy surged. From the horizons of its words shone forth the lights of the Day-Star of divine love, and from the heart of each of its letters blazed the fire of longing. His letter was a scroll of praise and a book of faithfulness. The Tree of Faithfulness has ever yielded and will continue to yield choice fruits. These appear through God's grace, the Lord of all worlds. By God's life! Through the presence of his letter, God ordained for him in the Crimson Book, from His Most Exalted Pen, that which none has discovered save His own Self.

As regards his turning towards the Desired One, outwardly there exist two obstacles: if he shows reserve towards the new governor, it will cause offense, while if he continues as before, he will be prevented from attaining the presence. However, God is witness and all atoms testify that specially for him the reward of attaining the presence has been revealed in the Book and remains fixed and established through God's will. Let him rejoice in this clear remembrance. He has been and remains oriented towards Us. Whenever time permits and wisdom allows, let him turn towards Us.

We beseech God, exalted be He, to assist him in what He loves and is pleased with, to reinforce him with the hosts of the seen and unseen, and to draw him near to Him in all conditions. Verily He is the Self-Sufficient, the Most Exalted. The glory from Us be upon him and upon those with him and those who love him and heed his word in this clear Cause.

## BH04144: Give thanks, O servant, unto thy Lord, for He… {.unnumbered}

He is the Ever-Abiding.

Give thanks, O servant, unto thy Lord, for He hath made thee to know His Beauty and hath appointed thee a servant unto Mine own Self; and from the horizon of the Robe hath the sun of glory and sanctity shone upon thee, that thou mayest rejoice within thy soul and remain steadfast upon the path of My love—whereat all who are in the heavens and on the earth rejoice. This is of the bounty of my Lord.

Hearken unto that which the night revealeth within the Lote-Tree of the Cause, and be not of those who hear not My words and cast My counsel behind their backs. Sanctify thyself from the world; then be patient in separation and be of those who are content with My decree.

There is no thing but with Us is its appointed term; and when its time is come it shall not be delayed. This is the ordinance of thy Lord for My sake. Be thou satisfied, then, with that which hath been decreed for thee, even as We were satisfied with that which the hands of the unjust have wrought against Me. Dost thou not behold how the earth was straitened for Me, and how My servants disputed with Me—those whom My most true Pen created?

Find thou repose within thyself; then endure in thy affair. Put thy trust in God, thy Lord, for He shall guard thee by His grace, even as He guarded thee aforetime, delivered thee from them that acted unjustly, chose thee above the people, and made thee a companion of His Beauty.

Beware lest thou forget the bounty of thy Lord, and hold fast unto the cord of My mercy. Be assured that He will not leave thee deprived of the wonders of His mercy that hath encompassed all contingent beings. This is of the nature of thy Lord—and also of My own disposition.

Be thou steadfast in My Cause, a Cause whereon none can stand firm save through My judgement and My decree. The Spirit be upon thee, that thou mayest be content with My good-pleasure.

## BH04182: To be typed {.unnumbered}

To be typed.

## BH04190: For some time now, the fragrance of fidelity has… {.unnumbered}

He is

For some time now, the fragrance of fidelity has not wafted from this bird of unfaithfulness to that land and realm, and no message of love has reached those mines of affection. However, this laxity in expressing love did not arise from the severance of the thread of love, and this negligence in showing eagerness did not stem from forgetting the covenant and pledge of affection. Rather, in the essence of the inner secret and hidden reality, the seas of fidelity were always surging and in motion, and in the heart and soul the lights and radiance of the sun of love were shining. If there was negligence in outward expression in the world of appearance regarding the spiritual messenger and heavenly letter in its coming and going, there was no shortcoming—for a ruined village pays no tax or tithe. This is because that inner connection has no severance or weakness, though this correspondence and communication may often be interrupted and suspended.

God is Most Great! What a paradise has been opened in these days, and what a carpet of divine unity has been spread, such that if a servant among God's servants be in the East of the world and another servant in the West, always does the easterner inhale the holy divine fragrances from the direction of the West, and this westerner catches the sweet scents of the spirit of love from the East. It is as if this distance of a hundred thousand leagues has taken on the ruling of a single step, and these countless waypoints have become as a mere span, for this vast distance can in no way prevent or block—and this is a truth in which there is no doubt, were people moving in the atmosphere of the spirit.

## BH04197: Praise be to the Beloved of all created things… {.unnumbered}

He is God, exalted be His glory.

Praise be to the Beloved of all created things, Who, with but a single glance, adorned the world with the ornament of being and guided it unto the Most Exalted Horizon. Glorified be the Creator, glorified His revelation and His manifestation, exalted His majesty, and mighty His Cause!

Some time ago a letter was dispatched unto your honoured presence, but no word of its arrival hath yet been received. We are the people of fidelity, and never have ye been forgotten, nor, God willing, shall ye ever be forgotten; for the world is illumined by the light of faithfulness, and for it a people have been appointed. Blessed is he who adorneth himself with its mantle and is illumined by its lights.

The dawning-place and manifestation of this Sun is the Will of God, exalted be His glory, and the place wherein His chosen ones, His pure ones, and His friends are accepted and illumined. God willing, may ye ever, through the unfailing favour of the Best-Beloved, remain radiant with the effulgences of the lights of His face, and arise in service unto His Cause. Verily, He answereth whomsoever He willeth, and guideth whomsoever He pleaseth unto His straight path.

Convey, on behalf of this wronged and imprisoned One, greetings unto all the loved ones of God who dwell in cities and lands and who are inebriated and gladdened by the Kawthar of divine love. From God, exalted be His glory, I implore and cherish the hope that He may enable them all to accomplish that which shall conduce to the exaltation of the Word and the upliftment of the Cause.

The mention of your honoured self hath been, and continueth to be, made within the Most Holy and Inviolable Court, and this is the most great glad-tiding from God, the Lord of mankind. The circlers round the Ka'bah of the Desired One, and the dwellers within the frequented House, send their greeting.

The glory that shineth forth from the horizon of the favour of God be upon you and upon those who are with you in the Cause of God, the Lord of all worlds.

## BH04281: Though the weeping of the clouds and the outcry… {.unnumbered}

He is the Almighty.

Though the weeping of the clouds and the outcry of the rain-laden sky be indeed the cause and occasion of the freshness of earth and mountain, of pillars and trees, of boughs and branches, and though they appear and are made manifest by the will of God, exalted and glorified be He, yet certain hindrances have arisen and have withheld the Beloved of the world from journeying and movement. The Lord of creation knoweth the people of unbelief, rebellion, turning away, and waywardness. Assuredly these clouds have themselves appeared from the clouds of hearts. God willing, through the divine favour and the lordly grace and mercy, they shall be dispelled, and the sun of joy shall be seen dawning and rising from the horizon of manifestation. Amen, amen, O Lord of all worlds!

As to Jinab-i-Diya and Badi'—upon them be the glory of God—God willing, let them occupy themselves with the remembrance of God and with meditation upon the signs of the handiwork of the Self-Subsisting; and let them beseech Him that He may illumine the horizon of the world through the effulgence of the Most Great Luminary—that is, that He may, by the blowing of the winds, cause the clouds to vanish, and vouchsafe deliverance unto the sun from its veil. Verily, He is the All-Powerful, the Almighty.

Glory be upon you. A few things were sent. The Greater Branch and Majd have repeatedly taken their own share; they have in no wise any right in the aforesaid things. It is not the exclusive property of Nur. To Khanum, however, they will assuredly give some portion through Vahid. My Mahd, in whatsoever manner she may choose to dispose of them, is free to do so—there is no harm in it. Aqa Mirza Musa—upon him be the glory of God—had formerly taken more than his allotted share. We convey greetings unto them all.

## BH04308: To be typed {.unnumbered}

To be typed.

## BH04309: To be typed {.unnumbered}

To be typed.

## BH11921: O My Name Mihdi! Upon thee be the peace… {.unnumbered}

He is God, exalted be His glory, the All-Wise, the All-Knowing

O My Name Mihdi! Upon thee be the peace of God and His glory! The letter from Ghulam-ʿAli which thou didst send to the Most Holy Court hath arrived. In truth, the previously mentioned word which states "tribulation is for those who are near" hath proven true in relation to his condition. Although the True One, the All-Knowing, the All-Informed, hath testified to the truth of these words, in these days their manifestation and appearance is witnessed more than before. We beseech God, blessed and exalted be He, to assist His loved ones to exercise beautiful patience and noble steadfastness. Aqa Ghulam hath endured much hardship, but this hardship is followed by mercy. Whatever occurs in the path of the Peerless Friend is beloved to the soul and the heart's desire. Mention of him hath repeatedly flowed and been revealed from the Pen of loving-kindness.

O thou who circlest round My Cause! Give him glad tidings from Me—the Sun of Permission hath dawned for him from the horizon of the heaven of God's will, the Lord of all worlds. They have moved with permission and proceeded with special intention. In the trials that have befallen them, they are rewarded, not questioned. Say:

> "My God, my God! Draw Thy loved ones nigh unto that station from which the fragrance of Thy meeting is wafted. O my Lord! They are Thy servants and Thy creation. They desire naught except to attain presence before the throne of Thy grandeur and to arrive at that place wherein Thy most sweet call and the shrill voice of Thy Most Exalted Pen are raised. O my Lord! Draw them nigh through Thy will, then cause them to enter through that gate which Thou hast opened unto the world through Thy Most Great Name. Verily Thou art the Almighty, the Mighty, the All-Bountiful."

## BH04566: O My Afnan! Upon thee be My glory… {.unnumbered}

He is God, exalted is He in wisdom and utterance

O My Afnan! Upon thee be My glory and My loving-kindness. Praise be to God, thou hast attained unto the dawning rays of the Sun of true divine unity. The signs of this most exalted station and the manifestations of this most sublime summit are now hidden, due to the weakness of sight. But ere long the Luminary of Will shall emerge from behind the clouds and become manifest.

Muhammad-Rida, upon him be My glory, is in these days present before Our face and dwelleth tranquil and at rest beneath the shade of the divine Tree of Providence. Although thou hast ever been remembered in the Most Holy Court, at this time the aforementioned one made mention of thee. Blessed be the one mentioned and the one who made mention. We beseech God to aid and assist the Afnans of the Tree in all conditions.

O My Afnan! The bestowals of God, exalted be His glory, have ever encompassed all times and circumstances. That Matter for which all have been created—all remain veiled and deprived thereof, while ye have ever received the greatest portion and fullest measure from the rain-showers of the heaven of God's mercy and the lights of the Orb of inner meanings. This is from your Lord's favor unto you. His be the praise for this most great bounty and mighty grace.

We send greetings and glad-tidings to those who have turned unto Him and have quaffed from the sealed wine. The glory shining forth from the heaven of God's mercy be upon you and upon those with you and upon those who love you for the sake of God, the Mighty, the All-Wise.

## BH04578: In My Name, the All-Subduing above all names {.unnumbered}

In My Name, the All-Subduing above all names

O thou who gazest upon the Countenance! Thy name hath been mentioned before the Wronged One, and He hath revealed for thee that which God hath made a sign of His might between His heaven and His earth, and a manifestation of His sovereignty to all who dwell in the unseen and the visible realm. Beware lest the doubts of the world or the clamor of the nations prevent thee. Arise to serve the Cause with such resolution that neither the hosts shall frighten thee nor the veils of them that have disbelieved in God, the All-Subduing, the Self-Subsisting, shall hold thee back. This is the Day which Muhammad, the Apostle of God, and before Him the Spirit, and before Him He Who conversed with God, made mention of, yet most of the people understand not.

Observe what the All-Merciful hath revealed in the Qur'an:

> "The Day when mankind shall stand before the Lord of all being and all that is to be."

We commanded Him Who conversed with God to lead the people out of darkness into light and to give them the glad-tidings of this Day wherein the Hour hath appeared and its signs, and that which was recorded in the Books of God, the Almighty, the Glorious, the All-Loving. The Truth hath appeared and revealed what He desired, despite the divines of the earth and its doctors of law who turned away from God and pronounced judgment against Him with such tyranny as caused the dwellers of the Kingdom to lament.

We counsel thee to remember God and praise Him in thy days. The world and all that thou beholdest today shall pass away, but there shall endure for thee what hath flowed from My Most Exalted Pen in thy name in this forbidden station. Thus have We illumined the horizon of the Tablet with the sun of utterance of thy Lord, the All-Merciful. He, verily, is the Truth, the Knower of things unseen. Rejoice thou in My remembrance of thee, then render thanks unto thy Lord at eventide and at dawn, at nightfall and at morn.

## BH11634: This is an epistle from the Wronged One… {.unnumbered}

This is an epistle from the Wronged One to him who turned toward God when most of mankind turned away...

All the world has awaited this Day, and the divine Books have given glad tidings of this Most Great Manifestation to all, and the Prophets and Messengers have promised all peoples this Day. Yet when the Day of God dawned from the horizon of His Will and became manifest, all turned away save whom God wished....

## BH04366: Praise be to God Who has distinguished His loved… {.unnumbered}

He is God, the Generous, the All-Bestowing

In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

Praise be to God Who has distinguished His loved ones with affliction as a recompense for what He promised them of abundant bounties. So praise be to God with praise that He loves and is pleased with, and which becomes a means of attaining His good-pleasure and presence. Therefore I am patient for God's sake, and upon Him do I rely, and to Him do I complain of my anguish and grief. Sufficient is God as a guardian and sufficient is God as a helper.

Several pages were written before, God willing they have arrived. Now as I write, it is the twenty-fourth night of the sacred month of God. Praise be to God, the blessing of health remains, and still no relief has appeared, except that a royal decree has arrived expressing countless favors. We shall see what is destined thereafter. An order was also sent to Yahya Khan, the governor of Urmia—apparently he has not accepted it, but this is not yet confirmed. We shall see what appears later.

I observed two pages in the noble handwriting. I have kept the number 60 until 40—whenever it is received along with 50, I will write the receipt later. No information has been received about the mother's journey. Apparently her journey is not yet confirmed. However much they wish to give funds, let them take 22 from the Siyyid's portion. In all matters they should watch over the affairs of the household. Show this very page to them, then take and keep it. May the peace of God be upon Mulla Ni'matullah and his friends. And peace is the best conclusion.

## BH04502: He says, glorified be His majesty {.unnumbered}

He says, glorified be His majesty:

He who turned to slay those who had faced the Most Exalted Horizon rose up against My murder. But when God revealed what was hidden in his breast, he cried out within himself and committed what he committed. To this testify the servants who were with Me in the Land of Mystery, and beyond them My Preserved Tablet. We made known to him Our horizon and commanded him to what is right, yet he arose to harm Me and committed that which caused the hearts of those near to God to melt.

Say: O people! The Revealer of the Bayan declared: O concourse of creation! Ye were created for His days. Fear God and be not of those who are veiled. Whoso hath attained unto but one word from Him—this is better for him than all that was revealed in the Bayan. Beware lest ye object to God and turn away from Him through Whom every wise command was manifested.

O thou who hast turned to the Countenance! When thou drinkest the choice wine of knowledge from the ocean of My utterance, remind the people with wisdom and exposition of what hath been revealed in the Tablet, that perchance they may arise to what they missed in the days of their Lord, the Mighty, the Praiseworthy. We see them in heedlessness and in their ancient stupor. Do thou remind them with wisdom, that perchance My wondrous remembrance may influence them. Thus have We adorned the heaven of the Tablet with the Sun of My Name, the All-Compelling over all who are in the heavens and the earth.

Convey My greetings to My loved ones who have cast away idle fancies and held fast to My Self-Subsisting Name, through which, when it appeared, the atoms proclaimed: The Kingdom belongeth unto God, the Lord of the Exalted Throne! Glory be upon thee and upon them and upon those who have turned with radiant faces to the Most Exalted Horizon on a Day wherein every mighty mountain was scattered to dust.

## BH04555: This is the Day whereon the Mother Book speaks… {.unnumbered}

He is the Speaker before the faces of creation

This is the Day whereon the Mother Book speaks forth and gives glad tidings unto all of this Revelation, through which the Dove of the Cause warbled in the Most Exalted Paradise. The Day has come, yet the people are in evident drunkenness. This is the Day whereon all things lament for what has befallen the Lord of all beings from those who denied God's proof and His evidence, having followed every remote oppressor. The rapture of the Call has seized all who are in earth and heaven. Blessed is he who has turned and attained, and woe unto the heedless. O people of God! Aid your Lord through wisdom and utterance and through that which the All-Merciful has sent down in His perspicuous Book. Beware lest the might of any heedless and remote one frighten you. This is the Day whereon the seas surge and the rivers flow and the mysteries are revealed, yet the people are behind a thick veil. We have heard your call and have answered you with verses that have caused the hearts of the mystics to soar. Say:

Praise be unto Thee, O my God, for having manifested Thy Cause and given glad tidings of Thy Revelation unto Thy servants and illumined their hearts with the light of Thy knowledge and shown them Thy Most Glorious Horizon and made them hear Thy Most Sweet Call. I beseech Thee, O Creator of the world and Helper of the nations, by Thy Name through which the believers have soared into the atmosphere of Thy nearness and the sincere ones unto the precincts of Thy glory, to aid me to such steadfastness as cannot be hindered by the world and its hosts and its ranks and its ornaments and its colors. O Lord! I am Thy servant, who has held fast unto the cord of Thy bounty and clung to the hem of Thy pardon and grace. I beseech Thee not to disappoint him from that which befits Thy days. There is no God but Thee, the Almighty, the Mighty, the Great.

## BH11633: This evanescent one offers himself as a sacrifice… {.unnumbered}

He is God, exalted be His glory, His is the greatness and majesty!

This evanescent one offers himself as a sacrifice to that Friend of Faran. Praise be to the Beloved of all worlds that the fire of divine attraction is ablaze in the heart and soul of that Friend with Merciful love. You are engaged in His remembrance and utterance of His praise. As for what was mentioned concerning the matters that have transpired, the greatest thing in creation is the good-pleasure of God, through whose grace and bounty you have been blessed with success, and the Truth is well-pleased with you. We beseech God to make you confirmed in all that He loves and is pleased with. Verily, there is no God but Him, the Lord of the last and the first.

And regarding the other petition that was submitted, it was presented before His presence, and these words were revealed in response:

He is God, exalted be His glory, His is the greatness and power!

Your letter has come before Us and We have heard that which you called out to God, your Lord and the Lord of what was and what will be. We beseech Him, exalted be He, to make you successful in all conditions and cause you to speak His remembrance in the kingdom of grandeur and glory, and to send down upon you that which will gladden your heart and establish the remembrance of your Lord among His creation. Verily, He is the One with power over whatsoever He willeth. There is no God but Him, the Protector, the Self-Subsisting.

In brief, what can I submit is this: I beheld the Sun of Divine Grace shining forth and resplendent in regard to your honored person. Thus much may be expressed: that in all conditions the glances of unfailing bounty have been, and continue to be, directed toward you, and that thou hast been remembered in lofty and wondrous mention; and, God willing, so shall it ever remain. And as to that which thou hadst set forth, the necessary recommendation is being made.

## BH04888: O thou who gazeth upon My countenance! Upon thee… {.unnumbered}

He is the One Who gazeth from His most exalted horizon.

O thou who gazeth upon My countenance! Upon thee be My glory and My loving-kindness. By My life! Thou hast been beneath the glances of My grace and in the shadow of the Tree of My Cause. We have made mention of thee in such wise that its fragrance shall never cease to perfume the realms of dominion and kingdom, and We revealed for thee aforetime that which caused the eyes of the most exalted Paradise to be consoled, and at this hour through this Tablet which proclaimeth that there is none other God but I, the All-Compelling, the Self-Subsisting. Behold, then make mention among the people of the Bayan—among them are those who turned away and those who denied, yet they neither understand nor perceive. By God's life! They know not that He Who spoke before the faces of all the world and preserved not Himself for less than a moment—from Him they have turned away.

Say: He hath come with that which no books in the world can equal. Fear God, and be not of them who turned away from the Truth, following vain imaginings and idle fancies. We have written for thee from My Most Exalted Pen that which shall gladden thy heart. Verily thy Lord is the Almighty over what was and what shall be. Remind My loved ones on My behalf and give them the joyful tidings of My promised Day, that the glad-tidings of God may draw them to a station wherein the conditions of creation shall not sadden them, nor the allusions of every rejected learned one. The Glory shining forth from the horizon of My kingdom be upon thee and upon them that are with thee and upon them that have laid hold on this mighty, this extended Cord.

## BH04791: Say: Glory be unto Thee, O Thou in Whose… {.unnumbered}

He is sanctified from all that hath been said or shall be said!

Say: Glory be unto Thee, O Thou in Whose hand is the dominion of all created things and in Whose grasp is the kingdom of all possibilities! I beseech Thee by the tears from the eyes of them that love Thee, and by the yearnings of the hearts of them that long for Thee, and by the fragrances of Thy verses and the sweet-scented breezes of Thy days, to protect us from those who speak that which would cloud the pure wine of Thy knowledge and alter the crystal waters of the Salsabil of Thy utterance.

How many a servant, O my God, do we see who claims association with Thee yet speaks that which would rend the veil of Thy glory before Thy creatures, supposing himself to be of those who are righteous in Thy days. Nay, by Thy glory! Rather he hath corrupted Thy Cause and spoken that which hath caused the hearts of the sincere ones among Thy chosen ones and the near ones among Thy loved ones to burn with grief.

We testify, O my God, that he who speaks today without Thy good-pleasure and contrary to what Thou hast revealed in Thy Tablets is more harmful than those who denied Thy proof and disputed Thy signs and turned away from Thy Self and disbelieved in the Dayspring of Thy Revelation and the Dawning-Place of Thy inspiration.

O Lord! Aid us to remember and praise Thee and to do as Thou hast commanded us in Thy Tablets. Thou art He Who hath made clear the proof and shown forth the way and sent down for Thy loved ones that which sufficeth them apart from all else, drawing them nigh unto Thee and distancing them from aught besides Thee. I beseech Thee to assist us in that which Thou hast commanded us outwardly in Thy Book; then ordain for us what befitteth our relationship to Thee. Verily, Thou art the Omnipotent over whatsoever Thou willest. There is no God but Thee, the All-Forgiving, the All-Bountiful.

## BH04781: The Wronged One hath heard thy mention and thy… {.unnumbered}

He is the Hearer, the Answerer.

The Wronged One hath heard thy mention and thy call, and mentioneth thee in this perspicuous Tablet, and beareth witness that thou hast turned toward the Most Exalted Horizon and testified to that which God Himself hath testified: that there is none other God but Him, the Mighty, the All-Bestowing. Thy tongue hath attained to confession, thy heart to turning unto Him, and thy face to orientation toward God, the Lord of the Final Return.

We make mention in the Persian tongue: The world hath been debarred from the recognition of the Lord of Names through vain imaginings and fancies. Consider the vain imaginings of the former people—how they were all deprived of the lights of the Dayspring of Manifestation and the Voice of the Speaker on Sinai. All must beseech God—glorified be His majesty—to preserve this people through His grace and not deprive them of the effulgent lights of the Sun of certitude. Great is this Day and mighty this Cause. Until they pass beyond the gulf of names, they shall not enter the Most Great Ocean.

Say: My God, my God! Praise be unto Thee for having shown me the waves of the ocean of Thy utterance and the effulgent lights of the Sun of Thy Manifestation, and for having brought me before Thy presence and caused me to enter the gate of the city of Thy knowledge. I beseech Thee, O Lord of the worlds, by Thy Most Great Name through which Thou didst subdue the cities of knowledge and understanding, and through which the fragrance of Thy garment was wafted among all religions, to make me steadfast, articulate and oriented toward the service of Thy Cause, Thy remembrance and Thy praise. Then inscribe for me through Thy Most Exalted Pen the good of this world and the next. There is none other God but Thee, the Ever-Forgiving, the All-Bountiful.

## BH04678: He saith, exalted be His words {.unnumbered}

He saith, exalted be His words:

O name of Jim and Vav! There hath come before the Wronged One what thou didst send to My name Mim, and the servant in attendance before My countenance hath read it. Blessed art thou for having attained the lights of certitude and believed in God when every distant idolater turned away.

Hearken unto what the Lord of Eternity calleth thee to in this Most Great Station. Verily there is none other God but Him, the Speaker, the All-Knowing. Grieve not over anything and put thy trust in God, the One, the All-Informed. Hold fast unto that whereby thy remembrance shall endure in the kingdom of thy Lord. Soon shall the world and all that is therein perish, and there shall endure what hath been inscribed by the Most Exalted Pen. Thy Lord is indeed the All-Knowing, the All-Encompassing.

Blessed is thy father who hath attained My good-pleasure, and thy brother for whom there hath been sent down from the heaven of grace that which hath diffused the fragrance of the Divine Shirt among the worlds.

Say: O my God and the Possessor of my heart! I beseech Thee by the Name through which the fire of love and affection was kindled amongst Thy servants, to make me enabled to serve Thee, speaking Thy praise, steadfast in Thy Cause, turning with my heart to the ocean of Thy good-pleasure, and soaring on the wings of detachment in the atmosphere of Thy will. O my Lord! I have turned to Thee with my whole being and I beseech Thee by Thy Self to ordain for me the reward of one who hath attained Thy presence, been honored to meet Thee, and drunk the choice wine of life from the ocean of reunion with Thee. Verily Thou art the Powerful over whatsoever Thou willest. There is none other God but Thee, the Supreme, the Most Exalted, the Mighty, the Impregnable.

## BH04882: O people of Saysan! Upon you be the glory… {.unnumbered}

He is the Most Holy, the Most Great, the Most Exalted, the Most Glorious

O people of Saysan! Upon you be the glory of the All-Merciful. You have ever been and continue to be remembered. Beware lest passion debar you from the Lord of all mankind. Take hold of the hem of the robe of your Lord's mercy, the Mighty, the Self-Subsisting. We have remembered and continue to remember the loved ones of that land. Blessed is the face that hath turned, the heart that hath been attracted, the tongue that hath spoken, and the hand that hath taken hold of My perspicuous Book. These are the days of manifestation and He Who conversed on Sinai is seated upon the throne of utterance. Strive that haply ye may attain unto that which is everlasting and enduring.

Jinab-i-Amin, upon him be My glory and loving-kindness, hath repeatedly made mention of the loved ones of that land and its surroundings and hath submitted their names to the Most Holy Court. We beseech God to assist you to remain steadfast in this mighty Cause and to adorn you with the ornament of His bounty.

Today the Pen is joyous, and the Tablet in rapture and gladness. Blessed is the one who hath been awakened by the call of the Most Exalted Pen from the slumber of heedlessness and hath arisen to serve the Cause of God. Give thanks unto your Lord for this great bounty and this loving-kindness which hath no peer in the kingdom nor likeness amongst all created things. Make mention of the steadfast handmaidens on behalf of the Wronged One and illumine them with the lights of the utterance of the Goal of all mankind.

The resplendent and effulgent light shining from the horizon of the heaven of proof be upon you, O My loved ones, and upon you, O My handmaidens, and upon all who are steadfast in all regions in the Cause of God, the Lord of Names and Attributes.

## BH04762: Blessed is the leaf moved by the winds… {.unnumbered}

He is God—exalted be His glory, to Whom belong grandeur and majesty.

Blessed is the leaf moved by the winds of her Lord's loving-kindness upon the Sadratu'l-ʿIrfan as He pleases, manifesting through her such love for her Lord that her remembrance endures among all peoples. Verily He has power over whatsoever He willeth.

The splendor of God be upon you, O my mother, for having believed in God, remained steadfast in His Cause, and been among those firm in His love.

O my mother! Your letter has reached this servant, adorned at its head with the crown of the Most Great Name, beginning after mention of this servant with:

> "I am yearning, I am grieving, I am needy, I am fearful..."

and so forth. This servant bears witness that you have ever been remembered, observed, present, near, honored, content, well-pleased, immortalized in the paradise of our Lord the All-Merciful's good-pleasure, and forgiven all sins by virtue of having turned to God, the All-Forgiving, the All-Generous.

Thereafter I presented the entire letter before the Throne of Oneness. The Sun of loving-kindness and favors rose and shone forth from its horizon, and a wondrous, sublime Tablet was specifically revealed from the heaven of the Lord of all worlds' grace. After perusing this clear Tablet, you will witness the divine favor and exclaim with both outer and inner tongue:

> "My spirit be a sacrifice for the wonders of Thy favors, O Beloved of the worlds and Goal of them that know, and O Thou in Whose mighty grasp lie the kingdoms of the heavens and earth!"

Praise be to God, the Lord of all worlds.

The servant of God

## BH04916: O Pen! Make mention of him who hath been… {.unnumbered}

O Pen! Make mention of him who hath been named Mihdi, that he may rejoice and be of them that render thanks. O Mihdi! Hear thou the call which hath been raised from this Most Exalted Station, from the Crimson Tree. Verily, there is none other God but Him, the Single, the One, the All-Knowing, the All-Informed.

They who have violated God's Covenant and His Testament—these are accounted among the most lost in the Book of God, the Lord of all worlds.

Say: O people! The Day hath come, and the Self-Subsisting calleth aloud through His Name, the Mighty, the Great. Beware lest what the ignorant possess prevent you from the Most Exalted Horizon. Take ye what ye have been given from One All-Knowing, All-Informed.

Blessed art thou and he who hath ascended unto God. We testify that he hath drunk from the Kawthar of immortality from the bounteous hand of his Lord, the Generous. He hath attained unto that which most of creation hath failed to attain. The Tongue of God beareth witness to this in this exalted station. He turned to the Most Exalted Horizon when the people turned away, save whom God, the Lord of the Kingdom of Names, did will. He recognized that which the Pen had spoken and acknowledged that which was sent down from the heaven of grace from One mighty and powerful.

We were with him at the time of his ascension and made mention of him in such wise as caused the ocean of forgiveness to surge and the fragrances of God's tender mercy, the Forgiving, the Merciful, to waft. Blessed is he and blessed is he who maketh mention of him after his ascension through that which hath been sent down from One ancient in descent. Glory be upon him and upon those who have not violated the Covenant of God, the Lord of the mighty throne.

## BH04860: As for the matter of forgiveness and pardon, after… {.unnumbered}

...As for the matter of forgiveness and pardon, after being presented, these verses were revealed. His exalted Word: "O Samandar! Upon thee be My glory and My loving-kindness. God hath forgiven thee through His grace, and what preceded of thy sin. Verily, He is the Most Merciful of the merciful. We beseech God to assist thee in all conditions to remember Him and to aid His Cause, and to ordain for thee what He hath ordained for His chosen ones, and to write down for thee, from the Pen of His bounty, the reward of those who are near and sincere. Verily, He is the Forgiving, the Merciful."...

As for the children, We have commanded that they first be educated in the principles and laws of religion, and afterwards in beneficial sciences, in trade adorned with the ornament of trustworthiness, and in such works as would serve to promote His Cause or give rise to that which would draw the servant nearer to his Lord. We beseech God to assist the children of His loved ones and to adorn them with the ornament of understanding, courtesy, trustworthiness and religiosity. Verily, He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.

## BH04875: O My Afnan! O leaf sprung from the Divine… {.unnumbered}

He is the One Who speaks with the most wondrous tongue in the Kingdom of Utterance!

O My Afnan! O leaf sprung from the Divine Lote-Tree! Hear My call, for verily it calls thee from the Most Exalted Station—the Station which hath been named by the Most Beautiful Names in the Crimson Book and in the Scriptures and Tablets. Thy letter reached Me and thy call was heard. By the life of God! Ye are beneath the shadow of My loving-kindness and the canopies of My grandeur. He hath remembered you, remembereth you, and will be with you wheresoever ye may be.

We beseech Him, exalted be He, to open before your faces the doors of His grace and bounty, and to ordain for you the good of this world and the world to come. In all conditions be ye engaged in the mention and praise of God, and be ye confident in His bounty. The rain of His mercy hath fallen and continueth to fall. Soon shall appear in the contingent world that which hath been ordained by the Pen of the All-Merciful. He, verily, is the Mighty, the Powerful.

Ask ye God to guide mankind and keep them steadfast, for this Day is mighty, and until they cross over the gulf of names they shall not enter the Most Great Ocean. By the life of God! All are in a strange slumber.

Convey thou My greetings to the children who are present there, then to those who are with thee. Each one of them, give them glad-tidings of God's loving-kindness and greet them from His presence. The kinfolk of Afnan and Aqa are related unto the Truth. This sufficeth them, by the Lord of all worlds!

The glory be upon you and upon every male and female believer who hath believed in God, the All-Knowing, the All-Informed.

## BH04677: My honoured and kindly brother! I cherish the hope… {.unnumbered}

He is God, exalted be His glory.

My honoured and kindly brother! I cherish the hope, from the presence of the Almighty—magnified be His bounty and exalted His generosity—that He may preserve your honoured self from every affliction and adversity, and vouchsafe unto you perfect health. He, verily, is the Bestower, the Compassionate.

Among the greatest of all bestowals granted by that Sovereign of existence is this: that He hath made pen and ink the interpreters of the heart’s hidden mysteries. This favour no treasure of the world can equal; nor can its praise be exhausted by any pen, nor its description be brought to an end by any tongue. Thus it is that the handwriting of that well-beloved friend and faithful companion imparteth strength unto the soul, and transformeth, according to what is meet and fitting, the darksome night of separation into the radiant morn of reunion.

Upon the arrival of thy noble letter, the signs of gladness, joy, delight, and exultation became manifest within the heart. The remembrance of friends is blessed indeed unto the friend. The one true God beareth me witness that from the day of separation until now, in the gathering of the true friends and spiritual lovers, the mention of that heavenly beloved hath been and remaineth ever upon our lips; and from every word of thy letter the fragrance of love was seen to diffuse itself and be breathed abroad.

Praised be God that we have not faded from remembrance; and from Him do we beseech that He may change the torment of separation into the sweetness of nearness and reunion, and cause the days of meeting to draw nigh. He, verily, is the Powerful, the Mighty, the Knowing, the Seeing.

## BH04709: In these days when in the heavens of manifestation… {.unnumbered}

He is God, the Most Glorious of the Most Glorious

In these days when in the heavens of manifestation the spiritual suns have risen from the horizons of visibility, and the effulgences of the Sun of the Most Glorious Countenance shine forth from the dawning-places of existence, and the dawnings of divine knowledge gleam from the eastern horizons of the Kingdom, the moons of wisdom, in accordance with their illumination from the Ancient Sun, are giving light in every direction, and the stars of eternity are shining with perfect radiance from the heavenly spheres of existence. It would be a pity if one possessed of insight and knowledge should still be illumined by the light of a setting star of idle fancies and seek enlightenment from the moon of imagination which is in eclipse. Nay, the Sun hath shone forth from the pole of the heaven of the world with wondrous new effulgences of light.

O friend! In these days the Ancient and Imperishable Beauty, the Unknowable Essence, Who was concealed behind a thousand thousand subtle veils of light, hath now appeared from behind the veil, and with but a single gleam from the effulgences of His countenance hath caused those who stood at Mount Sinai to swoon away and become as though they had never existed. Say: Verily, I have turned my face toward Him Who hath created the supreme heavens and hath rent asunder the lands of the Pharaohs, and I am not of those who join partners with God. Oh, oh! The Sun of Beauty hath made the world of hearts more radiant than the luminous day, and hath wiped clean from the tablets of hearts the rust of rational knowledge's manifestations. And God guideth whom He willeth unto the straight path. And the Spirit be upon thee.

## BH04712: At the end of this blessed Tablet We make… {.unnumbered}

He is God!

At the end of this blessed Tablet We make mention of Jinab-i-Kalb-ʿAli Khan and Janab-i-Husayn Khan and give them the glad-tidings of God's favors. Praise be to God, in the days of the Manifestation they attained to that which most of the people of the world remain heedless and deprived of. Blessed are they both and joy be unto them both. We beseech God to give them to drink from the Tasnim of steadfastness and the Salsabil of love, and to protect them from the doubts of the barking ones and the intimations of the transgressors. Verily He is the All-Bountiful, the Forgiving, the Merciful.

O people of God! Know ye the station of these days and hold fast unto that which will cause the exaltation of the Word of God and your stations. Verify not every utterance and be not assured by every soul, for the misguided ones present themselves with human courtesy and thereby deceive—for were their hearts' contents to be revealed, none would turn to them. Consider the misguided ones of the past who, with their white and red turbans, prayer beads and cloaks, and feigned asceticism and piety, afflicted the servants of God with such vain imaginings that on the Day of Judgment they all pronounced sentence against the Lord of the world. We beseech God, blessed and exalted be He, to protect His servants and guard them by His sovereignty from those who have denied His signs and turned away from His proof. Verily He is the Powerful over whatsoever He willeth through His word "Be" and it is.

The glory shining forth from the horizon of the heaven of My loving-kindness be upon you, O My loved ones, and upon those who have acted according to that which they were commanded in My perspicuous and wondrous Book.

## BH04872: To be typed {.unnumbered}

To be typed.

## BH04929: O Mahd! Upon thee be My glory and My… {.unnumbered}

O Mahd! Upon thee be My glory and My loving care.

Praise be to God! In this blessed month of Ramadan the excessive dampness hath not remained without being stirred, and all have rejoiced in the warmth of the love of God. The loved ones of God have held fast unto the mountain of fasting and have been content with its ordinance. In truth, such a deed in the path of God bestoweth life and conferreth strength. Through Divine assistance the ordinance of the Fast hath been fulfilled; it is hoped that the command of Prayer also may be carried out, that the fields of deeds may thereby become more illumined and more verdant and flourishing. The heaven of religion must, through the Most Great Luminary, be radiant and bright. Blessed are they that attain!

Seek ye not after news of us: the Cause is well, and our aim is well. In all conditions we are content and thankful.

The purpose of this letter is to remember thee in truth, and likewise to convey congratulations on the blessed month of Ramadan. To each of the people of that station convey, on behalf of the Wronged One, greetings, and tell them: the days of the joyous Feast are near. The sincere are saddened at its passing, while the godless rejoice.

Soon shall abstinence be changed to breaking of the fast; the blessed word shall set forth on a journey; and the beloved word shall find its resting-place. Then shall sighing arise from longing, and the light of freshness—hidden by the rigour of the Fast—shall, through bounty, have its veil lifted, and shall be revealed and made manifest.

Baha and peace be upon thee, and upon them, and upon the women likewise. From God do we seek assistance; He is the Helper, and He is the Sustainer.

## BH11638: Adorn the preface of the Mother of Utterance… {.unnumbered}

In the Name of the Everlasting Speaker!

Adorn the preface of the Mother of Utterance from the All-Merciful with these most exalted words: "Create me for Thyself."

Today, whosoever hath been attracted by the fragrance of the garment of Him Who conversed upon Sinai, and hath been illumined by the rays of the Sun of Truth, hath attained unto everlasting life, inasmuch as his name hath been inscribed by the Most Exalted Pen in the Crimson Book.

We testify to thy devotion, humility, submissiveness and orientation toward the face of God. Exalted is the station of this testimony. Every possessor of vision and hearing beareth witness to that which hath been revealed from the Pen of Power on this blessed night. It behooveth thee to occupy thyself with the Cause, with wisdom and utterance, in a manner that is befitting.

Convey My greetings to the loved ones in that land on behalf of this Wronged One. Say: Consider the time as precious. By the Sun of Truth, centuries and ages cannot be compared to a single moment of these days. Arise with the utmost endeavor to compensate for what hath passed. Blessed are they who are enkindled with the fire of love and who speak in remembrance of God, exalted be His glory.

Say: O friends! Through unity and concord, and through remembrance and utterance, illuminate the horizons. Strive that ye may perchance achieve such deeds as shall endure throughout the kingdom of earth and heaven.

The glory shining forth from the horizon of the heaven of My mercy be upon thee and upon them that are with thee, and upon those who have cast away all else save God, clinging fast to that which is with God, the Lord of the worlds.

## BH04953: O my God! This is Your servant upon whose… {.unnumbered}

He is the All-Glorious

O my God! This is Your servant upon whose heart's garden has wafted the sweet fragrances of Your holy love, and in whose inner being has spread the perfumes of Your yearning and ardor.

You have severed his attachment to all else through his passionate longing for You, fed him with the sweetness of Your remembrance, given him to drink from the choice wine of Your grace, led him to the fountain of Your knowledge, and called him to the realm of Your glorious oneness. Through this You have enriched him beyond all that was and shall be, for O my God, when You raise up one of Your servants to soar in the atmosphere of Your divine unity and move along the pathways of Your holy uniqueness, You make him rich through Your wealth, for all things are as nothing before the manifestation of a single sign of Your sovereignty, and all existence vanishes before the appearance of but one token of Your might and exaltation.

Though Your servants be the poorest of Your creation, yet through the breezes of Your love wafting over their hearts, they turn to naught save the wonders of Your beauty and seek shelter beneath no shade but the shade of the Sovereign of Your divinity.

I beseech You by Your love for them and their love for You to strengthen this servant through the invisible confirmations of Your eternity, immortalize him in the gardens of Your holy presence, and admit him to the paradise of Your oneness. Verily You are the Almighty, the Exalted, the Most High.

And praise be to You, O You in Whose grasp lies the reins of all things.

## BH11777: And further, whereas thou didst make mention… {.unnumbered}

And further, whereas thou didst make mention of the spiritual loved one, Jinab-i-Ibn-i-Abhar—upon him be the glory of God and His loving-kindness—his remembrance, in the Most Holy, the Most Exalted, the Most Inaccessible Court, attained the honor of being hearkened unto. This is that which hath been revealed for him from the Pen of the Will of our Lord, the All-Merciful. He, exalted be His glory and all-embracing His bounty, saith:

In My Name that Commandeth, the All-Informed!

O Ibn-i-Abhar! Upon thee be the Glory of God, Lord of Destiny. Hearken unto that which God, the Lord of all worlds, calleth thee. We cast upon thee aforetime that which, had it been cast upon the heavens, they would have been cleft asunder, had it been cast upon the earth, it would have been split apart, and had it been cast upon the mountains, they would have crumbled to dust. Verily thy Lord is the Helper, the All-Knowing. We have granted thee permission and have revealed for thee that which will draw thee to the Most Exalted Horizon, this glorious and wondrous station. It behooveth thee to make mention of what thou hast witnessed in the Tablets of thy Lord. Thus doth command thee He from Whose presence hath been sent down a perspicuous Book. The Glory shining forth from the horizon of the heaven of My loving-kindness be upon thee and upon those who have cast aside what is with the people, yearning for that which is with God, the Strong, the Mighty.

Praise be to God that His loved ones have been blessed by the tender mercies of the All-Merciful and have received their portion from the Most Great Ocean, especially the spiritual friend His honor Ibn-i-Abhar, upon him be the Glory of God, who hath both been mentioned and given permission. This evanescent servant conveyeth greetings to him and all the other loved ones, and beseecheth divine confirmation, success and protection for all.

## BH05076: To the Leaf, the sister who circles the Most… {.unnumbered}

To the Leaf, the sister who circles the Most Great, Most Wondrous Throne:

Glory be to Thee, O my God! This is a leaf from the leaves of this Tree which was raised up in truth and was stirred by the winds of Thy grace until she turned to the Dayspring of Thy Cause and the Dawning-Place of Thy loving-kindness, and acknowledged Thy oneness and confessed Thy singleness.

I beseech Thee, O Lord of Names and Creator of earth and heaven, to ordain for her what Thou hast ordained for Thy handmaidens who circle round the sanctuary of Thy presence and have attained to the visitation of Thy Beauty. O Lord! Decree for her that which will bring comfort to her eyes, then preserve her within the pavilion of Thy protection and the tabernacle of Thy safekeeping. Verily, Thou art the All-Bountiful, the Possessor of the Great Name.

Look upon her with the glances of the eyes of Thy mercy and illumine her heart with the light of Thy knowledge, in such wise that nothing shall prevent her from gazing toward the direction of Thy gifts. O Lord! Since she hath clung to the cord of Thy grace, deprive her not of Thy bounty and favor. Verily, Thou art the Mighty, the Wise.

Know thou, O my leaf, that the Word of Victory hath ascended to the Supreme Companion, and We were well-pleased with him. This Tablet beareth witness to that, and beyond it the Mother Book. He was among those who emigrated in the path of God until he came to rest beneath the shade of the Throne, and God is, of what I say, All-Knowing.

Say: O people! Speak not according to your desires. Fear God and follow not those who say that for which God hath given no leave. Speak with truth, for verily He is of all things All-Knowing and All-Witnessing.

## BH04990: Thou art He, O my God, through Whose names… {.unnumbered}

He is the Preserver, the Healer

Thou art He, O my God, through Whose names the sick are healed and the ailing are restored, and the thirsty are given drink, and the sore-vexed are tranquillized, and the wayward are guided, and the abased are exalted, and the poor are enriched, and the ignorant are enlightened, and the gloomy are illumined, and the sorrowful are cheered, and the chilled are warmed, and the downtrodden are raised up. Through Thy name, O my God, all created things were stirred up, and the heavens were spread, and the earth was established, and the clouds were raised and made to rain upon the earth. This, verily, is a token of Thy grace unto all Thy creatures.

I implore Thee, therefore, by Thy name through which Thou didst manifest Thy Godhead, and didst exalt Thy Cause above all creation, and by each of Thy most excellent titles and most august attributes, and by all the virtues wherewith Thy transcendent and most exalted Being is extolled, to send down this night from the clouds of Thy mercy the rains of Thy healing upon this suckling, whom Thou hast related unto Thine all-glorious Self in the kingdom of Thy creation. Clothe him, then, O my God, by Thy grace, with the robe of well-being and health, and guard him, O my Beloved, from every affliction and disorder, and from whatever is obnoxious unto Thee. Thy might, verily, is equal to all things. Thou, in truth, art the Most Powerful, the Self-Subsisting. Send down, moreover, upon him, O my God, the good of this world and of the next, and the good of the former and latter generations. Thy might and Thy wisdom are, verily, equal unto this.

## BH05226: O Muhammad! The days when thou didst take shelter… {.unnumbered}

O Muhammad! The days when thou didst take shelter beneath the blessed Tree are remembered in Our presence. The Greater Branch is now present and hath sought a special favor for thee. We make mention of thee through this clear remembrance.

Convey My greetings to the loved ones of that land. Say: Be not sorrowful, be not heedless. With wisdom and utterance, bestow the Kawthar of proof upon those who are receptive and ready. Praise be to God, ye are not among the corrupt ones, and therefore have been and continue to be preserved and protected by God, exalted be His glory.

Beseech God that He may assist the honored rulers—may God aid them—to achieve that which this Wronged One hath purposed, and this purpose is, in its primary station and first rank, the Will of God, exalted be His glory. Blessed is he who hath recognized and attained, and woe unto the heedless ones.

In these days this Wronged One is occupied with praise and thanksgiving to God, for He hath adorned the martyrs of the land of Ya with the crown of patience and the ornament of steadfastness, and aided them to hold fast unto that which was revealed and sent down in the Book from the Supreme Pen. Well is it with them and may they rejoice.

The glory be upon thee and upon those who love thee and upon My loved ones and chosen ones who have not broken My Covenant and have acted according to what they were commanded by the One Who is the Ordainer, the All-Wise.

## BH11639: A mention from Our presence unto him who was… {.unnumbered}

He is the Most Holy, the Most Illustrious, the Most Exalted, the Most Glorious!

A mention from Our presence unto him who was stirred by the breezes of revelation when the All-Merciful came with power and sovereignty, that the fragrances of the verses may seize him once again and draw him nigh unto God, the Lord of all religions. He verily remembereth at all times His servants who have turned with their hearts toward the direction of their Beloved and have cast behind them idle fancies and vain imaginings.

Though thy letter hath not been presented before the Throne, yet God maketh mention of thee through His grace, that thou mayest be assured of thy Lord's tender care. Beware lest earthly affairs extinguish thee. Be thou aflame with this Fire which proclaimeth from the midmost heart of creation: "There is none other God but Me, the Mighty, the All-Forgiving." Be thou steadfast in the love of thy Lord and firm in His Cause in such wise that through thee the banner of constancy may be planted upon the highest summits. They who are heedless this day are indeed the most remote of all creation in the sight of thy Lord—no portion have they in the Book.

Be thou thankful unto God that the countenance of the Adored One hath turned toward thee from this horizon whereby the horizons have been illumined. Say: O people! The world hath been illumined through the splendors of the countenance of your Lord, the All-Merciful. Beware lest the veils of glory withhold you from Him. Rend them asunder with the fingers of certitude, turning unto God, the Lord of the beginning and the end.

Thus have We sprinkled upon thee the drops of utterance from the ocean of thy Lord's favors, the Mighty, the Bestower. Verily, the glory be upon thee and upon those who are with thee, from thy Lord, the Mighty, the All-Bountiful.

## BH11640: The Resurrection hath come to pass and the Promised… {.unnumbered}

In the Name of the All-Compelling, the Self-Subsisting!

The Resurrection hath come to pass and the Promised One hath appeared. The Self-Subsisting calleth aloud: "There is none other God but Me, the All-Compelling, the Self-Subsisting!" He that hath arisen to serve God and make mention of Him, verily his Lord, the All-Knowing, the All-Informed, shall bestow His blessings upon him beneath the shadow of this Most Great Name. The mercy of God hath encompassed all who are in the heavens and on earth, yet most of the people remain heedless.

Should one ask any of the divines, "Why hast thou turned away from this Revelation, and by what proof didst thou recognize Muhammad, the Messenger of God, when He appeared?" he would reply: "That which hath appeared I find not in the books of old." Say: All that thou beholdest and utterest springeth from thine idle fancies. He appeareth not according to thy desire, but according to His Will. He, verily, is the Self-Sufficient, the All-Knowing, the Almighty, the All-Powerful.

Beseech thou God to rend asunder their veils and open their eyes that they may behold the lights of the Sun and turn towards it on this Most Great, Most Holy, Most Glorious, Most Wondrous Day. Soon will they hasten and say:

> "Woe unto us for what we have neglected in regard to God, and alas for our attachment to the books of men while turning away from Him Who was the Source of all books and the Dawning-Place of every clear tablet!"

None can protect anyone this Day save God, the Lord of the visible and the invisible, the Lord of all worlds. We beseech God to aid thee to remember Him and praise Him, and to ordain for thee that which He hath ordained for His chosen ones. Verily, He is the Mighty, the Generous.

## BH11776: Haji Siyyid Muhammad {.unnumbered}

Haji Siyyid Muhammad

In the Name of God, the Most Mighty, the Most Powerful.

Glorified be Him Who revealeth whomsoever He willeth through whatsoever He willeth, that he may arise to champion His Cause, manifest His decree, and divulge His secret. No God is there but Him, and unto Him shall all return.

O Muhammad! How dost thou fare in the land of the Lord? Render thanks unto thy Lord for that wherewith He hath singled thee out, and prostrate thyself before His Face, for We have indeed been watching over thee. Verily, We have sent down unto thee Our verses, that thou mayest thereby be numbered among them that bow in adoration.

Ask thou not of Me concerning aught, for I possess not the knowledge thereof. That is a mystery from the presence of One All-Knowing, All-Wise. O Muhammad! Present thyself before Ḥusayn, and aid him upon the earth, and be not of them that despair. By God! I have intended for thee naught but counsel. If thou desirest, accept it, and if not, turn thou away. Such is the decree sent down from Us, and We verily do decree.

Say: O concourse of the people of vain imaginings! Present yourselves before your Lord, if ye desire to be humble before God, the All-Merciful. We have annulled all learning save the knowledge of the verses and of supplications. Thus hath the command gone forth from Us, and with Us, verily, is the command.

Bear thou witness within thine own heart that the Remembrance is the Truth, though the people for the most part turn far away. Say: Praise be to God, Who hath guided me unto a manifest path of truth. Verily, all praise be to God, the Lord of the heavens, the Lord of the earth, the Lord of all worlds.

## BH05354: My Lord, pour forth patience upon Thy loved ones… {.unnumbered}

My Lord, pour forth patience upon Thy loved ones and assist them against the wrongdoing people.

In His Name that prevaileth over all names!

Some time ago the Most Holy, Most Exalted Tablet was sent. God willing, thou wilt attain unto it and inhale the fragrance of the loving-kindness of the All-Merciful. And now Jinab-i-Amin, that is, Abu'l-Hasan, hath mentioned thee and thy steadfastness and sincerity. Therefore this Most Holy, Most Exalted Tablet hath again been revealed and sent. Praise be to God, thou hast attained unto the Purpose and art aware of that which all people are heedless. This is among the great bounties of God, exalted be His glory. We counsel thee to observe wisdom in all conditions. Fix thy gaze upon Him in all circumstances. We beseech God that there may appear from thee that which shall endure throughout the duration of the kingdom and the heavenly realm, and that He may draw thee nigh unto Him in all conditions. Verily He is the Self-Sufficient, the Most Exalted.

Thy hardships are witnessed and remembered before God and are inscribed by the Most Exalted Pen in the Crimson Book. Be thou thankful unto thy Lord for this manifest grace. That which thou didst send hath arrived and was honored with acceptance. The glory shining forth from the horizon of eternity be upon thee and upon those who act in accordance with that which they were bidden in the Book of God, the Lord of all worlds. Praise be to God, the Lord of this manifest Day.
